description: Session signals reported by the dev-agent runners, one per turn: agent, channel (whatsapp|webchat|handoff|schedule|fitness|takt — takt = runner schedule rows takt-<agent> and the Analyse-Agent), person, aufgetreten_am (in the session) and erfasst_am (at the server), tool calls, tool errors [{werkzeug, meldung, fehlerart_id}], rueckfrage (bot ended with a question), wiederholung (human repeated the same request), unmut (null|leicht|stark; unmut_offen = suspected, not yet classified) with a short quote (unmut_beleg — only for tenant admins and superadmins, null for everyone else), tokens per model. Plus totals for the period (signals, with errors, follow-up questions, repeats, frustration, tokens per model). Defaults to the last 24 hours. Admins, planners and agents only.

bis.description: Until (ISO time or YYYY-MM-DD = end of that day). Default: now.

limit.description: Max signals returned (default 200, max 500); the totals cover up to 2000.

nur_fehler.description: Only turns with at least one tool error

von.description: From (ISO time or YYYY-MM-DD). Default: 24 hours ago.

name: list_sitzung_signale
